result.question: Which of Tesla, Apple, and Nvidia had the highest revenue in their most recent fiscal years, and what were the figures?
result.answer: Among Tesla, Apple, and Nvidia, Apple had the highest revenue in its most recent fiscal year. Tesla reported revenues of $94.827 billion for fiscal year 2025, which ended December 31, 2025 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2025-12-31]. Apple reported total net sales of $416.161 billion for fiscal year 2025, which ended September 27, 2025 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2025-09-27] [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p001]. Nvidia reported revenue of $215.938 billion for fiscal year 2026, which ended January 25, 2026 [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:Revenues:2026-01-25]. Therefore, Apple's $416.161 billion in revenue was the highest among the three companies.
